title: Prime Minister highlights transformative impact of Jan Dhan Yojana
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has highlighted the unprecedented scale and transformative outcomes of the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana in last 12 years. Shri Modi said that Jan Dhan Yojana has had an unparalleled impact, playing a significant role in advancing financial inclusion and empowering people across the country.
The Prime Minister posted on X:
Unprecedented scale and transformative outcomes!
Jan Dhan Yojana has had an unparalleled impact.
#12YearsOfJanDhan
Unprecedented scale and transformative outcomes! Jan Dhan Yojana has had an unparalleled impact. #12YearsOfJanDhan https://t.co/vxYoOnhPSW — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 28, 2026
***
MJPS/SS/VJ

enrichment.summary: On the occasion of 12 years of the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), Prime Minister Narendra Modi posted on social media platform X praising the scheme's 'unprecedented scale and transformative outcomes' in advancing financial inclusion. The release consists solely of this celebratory social media post with the hashtag #12YearsOfJanDhan, without any new data, statistics, or policy announcements.
enrichment.context:
The Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana was launched in August 2014 as India's flagship financial inclusion programme, aiming to provide every household access to a basic bank account, credit, insurance, and pension facilities. Over the years it has been credited with enabling direct benefit transfers, reducing leakages in welfare delivery, and forming the foundation of the JAM (Jan Dhan-Aadhaar-Mobile) trinity that underpins India's digital public infrastructure. The scheme is frequently cited in policy discourse as a landmark in expanding banking penetration, particularly among women and rural populations, and its account numbers have grown to several hundred million over the past decade.

This particular release, however, is merely a reproduction of the Prime Minister's congratulatory social media post marking the anniversary, containing no new statistics, scheme modifications, or policy content beyond a general statement of appreciation. While PMJDY itself remains a highly examinable topic in the context of financial inclusion and welfare delivery, this specific communication does not add substantive material for study purposes.
